node_types.name: Subrole
node_types.definition: An internal worker process within gateway that handles a specific class of incoming client interaction (RPC requests, websocket subscriptions, or metrics queries). Stateless beyond per-request locals; collaborates with sidecars and external services

node_types.name: Listener
node_types.definition: The outer connection acceptor: terminates HTTP and websocket framing for traffic forwarded by edge, parses the minimal envelope (route, protocol version, API key header), and dispatches each connection or request to the appropriate Subrole. Holds no per-tenant state

node_types.name: Sidecar
node_types.definition: An in-process cross-cutting helper used by every Subrole on the request hot path (e.g. auth/throttle gate). Exists once per gateway process and is invoked synchronously by the Subroles

node_types.name: External
node_types.definition: A collaborator that lives outside the gateway scope (in the parent architecture) but is referenced here so its coupling to gateway internals is visible. The boundary node is a stand-in for the parent component, not a re-implementation

nodes.definition: Outer HTTP/WS connection acceptor and in-process control plane: terminates HTTP and websocket framing for traffic forwarded by edge, parses minimal envelope (route, protocol/schema version handshake, API key header, chain_router-supplied per-method cost class for RPCs), and dispatches each connection or request to the appropriate Subrole. Owns the in-process hybrid logical clock — refreshes from region_coordinator on a documented cadence and on skew-threshold transitions, and exposes a single HLC snapshot to every Subrole and Sidecar via a process-local accessor (Subroles never call region_coordinator for HLC directly). Persists last-known protocol-version, residency hints, and HLC seed to a local read cache; on startup serves traffic from last-known-good values when region_coordinator is unreachable and surfaces the degraded state in metrics. Applies a region-wide concurrent-handshake admission budget and emits jittered-backoff hints to clients past the threshold. Aggregates per-Subrole liveness (in particular fanout-suspended from subscription_path) into a region-level health surface that edge_filter consumes for residency-aware traffic shifting. Holds no per-tenant state

Handles JSON-RPC request handling: receives a dispatched RPC envelope (with chain_router-supplied per-method cost class hint from the listener), runs auth_check, and forwards the chain-native RPC payload verbatim to chain_router (passthrough — no schema rewrite). Maintains a partitioned in-flight slot pool keyed by cost class (short-RPC and long-RPC pools) so long-tail historical queries cannot starve short ones; over-budget long-tail traffic surfaces a 'try chunking' error rather than blocking. For streaming or chunked RPC responses, re-evaluates the tenant's throttle-flag version (from auth_cache via the auth_check re-check path) before yielding further chunks; stops yielding when the flag becomes set. Attaches finality metadata returned by chain_router to the response payload. Emits per-request and per-chunk usage signals to usage_meter. Reads HLC bucket from the listener's process-local accessor (not region_coordinator). Stateless beyond the in-flight slot bookkeeping

Handles WebSocket subscription lifecycle: receives a dispatched WS upgrade with subscription parameters (chain, kind, address filters, confirmation threshold, optional resume cursor), runs auth_check, and registers the subscription with fanout — coalescing concurrent subscribes into per-chain batches under reconnect-storm load to bound fanout's subscribe-RPC fan-out. Forwards every event fanout returns to the client connection; forwards rollback notifications, finality tags, and pending-tx state-machine transitions verbatim. Enforces a bounded per-subscription egress queue with a documented overflow policy: on overflow, emits a 'slow-consumer' control event to the client and reports the consumer rate back to fanout so its ring-buffer cursor stays bounded; persistent overflow may force-unsubscribe the slow client with a documented reason. Operates a fanout-liveness watchdog: on extended fanout unreachability or sustained subscribe failure, emits a 'stream-suspended' control event carrying the last-known cursor and reconnect guidance, and surfaces the suspended state to the listener health surface. Re-evaluates the tenant's throttle-flag version on a documented interval; tears down the subscription with an explicit control event when the flag becomes set. Reads HLC bucket from the listener's process-local accessor. No per-subscription registry state lives here — fanout owns the registry, ring buffer, cursor positions, and address index

Handles tenant metrics read API: receives a dispatched HTTP request for tenant usage/error/latency/rate-limit-headroom metrics, runs auth_check, and queries metrics_store scoped to the authenticated tenant (and only within tenant's residency-allowed regions). Enforces a per-tenant query-cost budget for metrics-API requests (window size, cardinality, and per-second cap) separate from the RPC rate limit; over-budget requests are rejected with explicit chunking guidance. Routes heavy queries to a documented metrics_store read path (read replicas or async result jobs) so they don't contend with usage_meter writes. Reads HLC bucket from the listener's process-local accessor. Read-only; never writes counters or state

In-process authentication and rate-limit/throttle gate invoked synchronously by every Subrole on every incoming request or subscription. Splits the hot path (synchronous auth_cache lookup, residency check, throttle-flag check, in-memory HLC-bucketed rate-limit counter increment) from the cold path (asynchronous tenant_store hydration on cache miss). Hot path is non-blocking and never reaches tenant_store; cold path queues hydration in the background and either rejects with a documented 'cache-miss' decision or, for high-confidence keys, accepts on a documented optimistic path with eventual reconciliation — Subroles never make this decision themselves. Exposes a bulk-hydrate batch path that the listener invokes during reconnect-storm-prewarm to fan-in tenant_store fetches into one request. Honours revocation tombstones from auth_cache immediately on TTL refresh. Exposes a re-check API used by request_path and subscription_path to re-evaluate the per-tenant throttle-flag version on long-running paths cheaply. Reads HLC bucket from the listener's process-local accessor (not region_coordinator). Emits a 'rejected-request' usage signal to usage_meter on every rejection (with reason: rate-limit, throttle, residency, revoked, malformed-auth) so per-tenant cost attribution covers rejection load and key-anomaly detection sees the rejection signal. Surfaces a degraded-mode metric whenever serving auth from existing auth_cache entries because tenant_store is unreachable

Boundary stand-in for the parent edge service: residency-aware anycast router that terminates TLS, applies IP rate-limiting, WAF, and bot mitigation, and forwards only API-key-bearing traffic to the gateway listener in residency-allowed regions, with reconnect-storm hints on disconnect
Boundary stand-in for the parent auth_cache: regional tenant-credential and rate-limit-state cache with TTLs, throttle-flag fast path, and bulk hydration paths
Boundary stand-in for the parent tenant_store: canonical multi-region tenant + key + plan store with residency partitioning, single-writer-per-key, and tombstoned revocations
Boundary stand-in for the parent chain_router: per-chain pool router that selects healthy replicas, separates archive from pruned tiers, enforces query-cost budgets, and emits cost signals

Boundary stand-in for the parent fanout: subscription-multiplex service that owns subscriber registry, address index, ring buffers, cursors, finality tagging, rollback emission, and pending-tx state machine
Boundary stand-in for the parent usage_meter: per-tenant cost-driver aggregation, plan-ceiling enforcement, anomaly detection, and metrics_store writer
Boundary stand-in for the parent metrics_store: residency-sharded per-tenant time-series store retaining at least 30 days of usage/error/latency/rate-limit-headroom metrics

Boundary stand-in for the parent region_coordinator: global control plane providing the hybrid logical clock, current protocol/schema version, residency policy, throttle fast-path, and canonical-tip quorum

requirements.description: Every dispatched RPC, websocket, or metrics request is authenticated to a tenant via API key before it reaches a Subrole's business logic
Per-API-key request-rate and quota enforcement happens inside the gateway process before the request is forwarded to chain_router or fanout
request_path forwards each chain's JSON-RPC method calls verbatim to chain_router with no cross-chain schema rewrite
subscription_path accepts WebSocket subscriptions for new block headers and forwards the stream from fanout
subscription_path accepts WebSocket subscriptions for pending/unconfirmed transactions (incl. Cardano Ogmios local-tx-monitor) and forwards the stream from fanout
subscription_path accepts WebSocket subscriptions for watched-address activity and forwards the matched stream from fanout
subscription_path forwards explicit rollback notifications and finality status emitted by fanout to the subscriber connection
subscription_path accepts a per-stream confirmation threshold parameter on subscribe and passes it to fanout
subscription_path holds no per-subscription registry state; fanout owns the registry, ring buffer, and cursor positions
auth_check resolves API keys via auth_cache and only consults tenant_store on cache miss
On tenant_store unreachability, auth_check serves auth from existing auth_cache entries and surfaces a degraded-mode metric
auth_check honours revocation tombstones from auth_cache immediately on TTL refresh, supporting hot replacement and multiple active keys per tenant
listener advertises the gateway's protocol/schema version on every response and websocket subscription handshake, sourced from region_coordinator

request_path and subscription_path emit per-request and per-event cost-driver signals (request count, response bytes, websocket egress) to usage_meter so per-tenant cost can be attributed in near-real-time
auth_check rejects requests when the throttle flag for a tenant is set in auth_cache (propagated by region_coordinator) so plan-ceiling decisions are honoured fast-path in every region
metrics_api authenticates the tenant and reads only that tenant's metrics from metrics_store, returning per-key usage, error, latency, and rate-limit-headroom data

auth_check and the Subroles use the hybrid logical clock from region_coordinator for time-bucketed enforcement; observed inter-region skew above the threshold puts the local gateway into a documented degraded mode that surfaces in metrics
request_path forwards historical-state JSON-RPC requests verbatim to chain_router; archive vs pruned tier selection happens in chain_router
subscription_path accepts an optional resume cursor parameter on subscribe and passes it to fanout for ring-buffer replay
listener accepts inbound traffic only from edge_filter; no public network path exists directly to listener
request_path attaches finality metadata returned by chain_router to the response payload; subscription_path forwards finality tags emitted by fanout
auth_check enforces the tenant's residency policy on every request; metrics_api scopes metrics_store reads to the tenant's residency-allowed regions

subscription_path enforces a bounded per-subscription egress queue with a documented overflow policy (gap-marker, slow-consumer signal, or forced unsubscribe); fanout receives consumer-rate feedback from subscription_path so the ring buffer advance and per-subscription cursor stays bounded

listener applies a documented region-wide concurrent-handshake admission budget and emits jittered-backoff hints to clients above the threshold so reconnect storms cannot exceed the gateway's hot-path capacity
auth_check exposes a bulk-hydrate batch path so listener can pre-warm auth_cache for the API keys observed in a handshake batch, bounding tenant_store fan-out under reconnect storms
subscription_path coalesces fanout subscribe calls into per-chain batches under reconnect-storm load so fanout's subscribe RPC is not saturated by individual registrations

subscription_path detects fanout unreachability or sustained subscribe failure within a documented bound and surfaces it to clients via an explicit stream-suspended control event carrying the last-known cursor and reconnect guidance

listener exposes per-Subrole liveness (in particular fanout-suspended) to the edge-level health surface so edge_filter and anycast can shift subscription traffic away from a region whose fanout is degraded

metrics_api enforces a per-tenant query-cost budget for metrics-API requests (window size, cardinality, and per-second cap) separate from the RPC rate limit; over-budget requests are rejected with explicit chunking guidance
metrics_api routes heavy queries to a documented metrics_store read path (read replicas or async result jobs) that does not contend with usage_meter writes

auth_check separates the synchronous hot path (auth_cache lookup, in-memory checks) from the asynchronous cold path (tenant_store hydration), so a slow tenant_store fallback on one key cannot stall hot-path auth for warm keys across Subroles

Long-running paths (active websocket subscriptions, streaming or chunked RPC responses) re-evaluate the per-tenant throttle flag in auth_cache on a documented interval; subscription_path tears subscriptions down with an explicit control event when the flag becomes set, request_path stops yielding further chunks

listener persists last-known protocol-version, residency hints, and HLC seed across restarts and starts serving traffic from last-known-good values when region_coordinator is unreachable, refreshing in the background and surfacing the state in metrics

listener is the single in-process source of the hybrid logical clock for every Subrole and Sidecar; Subroles read HLC via a process-local accessor and never fetch HLC from region_coordinator directly, so all Subroles share the same HLC snapshot for any given request

request_path partitions its in-flight slot pool by chain_router-supplied per-method cost class so long-tail RPC traffic cannot starve short-RPC traffic; over-budget long-tail requests surface a documented 'chunk this query' error rather than blocking

auth_check emits a usage signal to usage_meter on every rejection, tagged with the reason (rate-limit, throttle, residency, revoked, malformed-auth), so per-tenant cost attribution covers rejected-traffic load and key-anomaly detection sees the rejection signal

satisfactions.explanation: All three Subroles invoke auth_check at the start of each request; auth_check resolves the API key against auth_cache (tenant_store on miss) and rejects unauthenticated requests

auth_check increments the per-key rate-limit counter in auth_cache and rejects requests that exceed the configured limit; request_path and subscription_path call auth_check before forwarding to chain_router or fanout
request_path is defined to forward the chain-native RPC payload verbatim to chain_router with no schema translation
subscription_path accepts the subscription parameters and registers them with fanout; fanout returns the new-heads stream which subscription_path forwards to the client
Same subscription_path path supports the mempool subscription kind by registering the kind with fanout, which produces the chain-specific pending-tx stream (incl. Cardano Ogmios local-tx-monitor)
subscription_path forwards the address-filter parameters to fanout, which uses its address index to deliver only matched events back to subscription_path
subscription_path is defined to forward rollback notifications and the canonical replay emitted by fanout verbatim to the subscriber connection
subscription_path accepts the confirmation-threshold parameter on the WS subscribe envelope and passes it through to fanout's subscription registration call
subscription_path is defined to hold no per-subscription state; fanout (External) owns the subscriber registry, ring buffer, and cursor positions
auth_check is defined to read auth_cache on the hot path and only fall back to tenant_store on cache miss
auth_check's definition includes the tenant_store-unreachable fallback: serve auth from existing auth_cache entries and emit a degraded-mode metric
auth_check is defined to honour revocation tombstones from auth_cache on every TTL refresh, supporting hot replacement and multiple active keys
listener calls region_coordinator on startup and TTL refresh to learn the current protocol/schema version, and is defined to advertise that version on every response and WS handshake it produces
request_path emits a per-request usage signal to usage_meter; subscription_path emits per-event egress signals to usage_meter; usage_meter (External) does the per-tenant attribution
auth_check checks the throttle flag in auth_cache (which region_coordinator pushes when a plan ceiling is crossed) and rejects the request before any chain_router or fanout call
metrics_api is defined to authenticate the tenant and read only that tenant's metrics from metrics_store, scoped to residency-allowed regions

listener seeds the HLC from region_coordinator; auth_check uses HLC-bucketed counters for time-bucketed enforcement; both are defined to enter the documented degraded mode when observed skew exceeds the threshold
request_path's definition forwards historical-state RPCs to chain_router verbatim; tier selection (archive vs pruned) is chain_router's job
subscription_path accepts the optional resume cursor on subscribe and passes it to fanout, which performs ring-buffer replay
edge_filter -> listener edge captures the inbound boundary; listener is defined to accept only edge-forwarded traffic with API-key headers
request_path attaches the finality metadata chain_router returns; subscription_path forwards the finality tags fanout emits
auth_check enforces residency policy as part of the auth check; metrics_api is defined to scope metrics_store reads to the tenant's residency-allowed regions

subscription_path's redefinition specifies a bounded per-subscription egress queue with a documented overflow policy (slow-consumer control event, consumer-rate feedback to fanout, force-unsubscribe on persistent overflow)
listener's redefinition includes the region-wide concurrent-handshake admission budget and jittered-backoff hints to clients past the threshold
auth_check's redefinition exposes a bulk-hydrate batch path that listener invokes during reconnect-storm prewarm
subscription_path's redefinition coalesces concurrent subscribes into per-chain batches to bound fanout's subscribe-RPC fan-out under reconnect-storm load
subscription_path's redefinition operates a fanout-liveness watchdog and emits a 'stream-suspended' control event with last-known cursor and reconnect guidance
listener's redefinition aggregates per-Subrole liveness (including fanout-suspended) into a region-level health surface that edge_filter consumes for residency-aware traffic shifting
metrics_api's redefinition enforces a per-tenant query-cost budget (window size, cardinality, per-second cap) separate from the RPC rate limit, with explicit chunking guidance on rejection
metrics_api's redefinition routes heavy queries to a documented metrics_store read path (read replicas or async result jobs) that does not contend with usage_meter writes

auth_check's redefinition splits hot (synchronous auth_cache + in-memory checks) from cold (asynchronous tenant_store hydration), with a documented 'cache-miss' decision and an optional optimistic accept path; Subroles do not make the decision themselves

auth_check exposes a re-check API; request_path re-evaluates throttle-flag version before yielding chunks; subscription_path re-evaluates on a documented interval and tears down with an explicit control event when flagged

listener's redefinition persists last-known protocol-version, residency hints, and HLC seed and starts in a documented last-known-good mode when region_coordinator is unreachable, with the degraded state visible in metrics

listener's redefinition makes it the sole in-process HLC source; request_path, subscription_path, metrics_api, and auth_check now read HLC via the listener's process-local accessor (the previous direct edges to region_coordinator have been removed)
